Description: Modified Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) Item 1 (Adequacy of case definition): evaluates whether standardized diagnostic tools were used vs. self-report scales/unclear methods.
Example values: 1 = Yes, standardized diagnostic tools used (*); 0 = Self-report scales, unclear methods, or no description

Description: Modified NOS Item 2 (Representativeness of the cases): evaluates whether the sample comprises a consecutive or obviously representative series of cases.
Example values: 1 = Consecutive or obviously representative series of cases (*); 0 = Potential for selection biases or not stated

Description: Modified NOS Item 3 (Selection of Controls): evaluates whether healthy controls were recruited from the same population as the ADHD group.
Example values: 1 = Controls recruited from the same population as ADHD group (*); 0 = Control source unclear or significantly different

Description: Modified NOS Item 4 (Definition of Controls): evaluates whether controls were actively excluded for psychiatric disorders via structured interviews.
Example values: 1 = Controls excluded for psychiatric disorders via structured interviews (*); 0 = Only self-reported no psychiatric history

Description: Modified NOS Item 5 (Comparability on primary factors): evaluates whether the study controls for age and sex between cases and controls.
Example values: 1 = Study controls for age and sex (*); 0 = Not controlled

Description: Modified NOS Item 6 (Comparability on secondary factors): evaluates whether the study controls for ADHD subtype.
Example values: 1 = Study controls for ADHD subtype (*); 0 = Not controlled

Description: Modified NOS Item 7 (EEG data acquisition & preprocessing): evaluates whether explicit sampling rate, bandpass filtering, and artifact removal parameters are reported.
Example values: 1 = Explicit sampling rate, bandpass filtering, and artifact removal (*); 0 = Incomplete parameters or vague methods

Description: Modified NOS Item 8 (Standardization of EEG data collection condition): evaluates whether EEG recording conditions, lab environment, and experimental paradigm were standardized.
Example values: 1 = Controlled EEG recording conditions, lab environment, or experimental paradigm (*); 0 = Not mentioned or large variability

Description: Modified NOS Item 9 (Medication usage control): evaluates whether ADHD medication usage and washout/interruption duration prior to testing were explicitly specified.
Example values: 1 = Specified ADHD medication usage and time of interruption (*); 0 = Failure to provide detailed medication info or discontinuation period

Description: Total quality score calculated as the sum of stars/points awarded across Q1 through Q9 on the modified Newcastle-Ottawa Scale.
Example values: Integer sum ranging from 0 to 9 (e.g., 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)
